notes_for_editor: Name and county: the Weldon community that shares this name is listed in Houston County in the Wikipedia infobox (coordinates about 31.02167, -95.57139), not Walker County. Both lists put the tower in Walker County, so the record's county is kept, but any link between the name and the community is unconfirmed. The Forest Lookouts (W) page gives only the county and agency and does not mention Weldon, so the story does not treat it as the same tower. No design, station description, construction date, staffing or fire history found.
